review_scope: Read-only eligibility audit of the 49 environment/node_modules/cache rows in cleanup-selection-v3. No candidate was moved, renamed, pruned, or deleted; no source or dependency inputs were changed. Version 2 corrects only candidate row 18 after readback of the exact late consumer command, environment setup, and committed DFI handoff; all other candidate row decisions are carried forward unchanged.
action_authorization: NONE. This report is an eligibility recommendation for the root-owned release ledger; it is not a Trash instruction.
global_release_conditions: All owning audits and the complete C ledger must be closed; useful code and deciding evidence must be committed and read back from the final branch.
Only the exact path rows marked RECOMMEND_ELIGIBLE_AFTER_ROOT_RELEASE may be considered; source extractions and other preserve-only roots are excluded.
Before any move, re-census the exact admitted roots and verify current branch/head/tree/status, category, path type, owner, and fresh device+inode. Any mismatch holds the path.

Preserve every raw probe, fixture, CAS/DB, output/readback, archive, wheel/sdist/dist, source extraction, MIG current artifact copy, original/shared environment, production data, and shared cache; do not remove a containing raw root recursively.
Keep shared UV cache intact. For candidates nested under raw/installed, any future move must target only the exact venv/buildenv directory, after non-overlap with sibling artifacts is checked.
Root must independently authorize and record a per-move Trash intent/receipt after its full-ledger review; this report grants no permission to act.
